body.content: Exploring systematic geometric constructions for 13 points in the unit square to maximize minimum triangle area. The primary challenge is avoiding colinear and near-colinear triples. The 4x4 grid missing one corner provides a baseline with zero area due to colinearities. The conjecture is that an optimal or near-optimal configuration requires breaking all structural symmetries while maintaining a roughly uniform distribution. Candidate strategies include: 1) A perturbed 4x4 grid. 2) A hexagonal-like packing adapted to the square. 3) A symmetric star-like pattern with perturbed colinearities. We need to compute the exact coordinates and verify the minimum area for each.
body.why_keep_this: To track the transition from naive structured grids to optimized configurations that actively avoid colinearities.
